name: floating-menu
title: Floating Menu
description: A floating navigation menu with staggered link reveals and animated toggle lines.

usage.label: Astro
React
Vue
usage.code:
<script setup>
import "@/components/motion-kit/floating-menu-element.ts";

const menuGroups = [
  {
    title: "Explore",
    links: [
      { label: "Home", href: "/" },
      { label: "About", href: "/about" },
      { label: "Contact", href: "/contact" }
    ]
  },
  {
    title: "Resources",
    variant: "muted",
    links: [
      { label: "Blog", href: "/blog" },
      { label: "Docs", href: "/docs" }
    ]
  }
];

const logoHtml = `<svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/></svg>`;
</script>

<template>
  <motion-floating-menu
    :menu-groups="JSON.stringify(menuGroups)"
    :logo-html="logoHtml"
    :primary-button="JSON.stringify({ label: 'Get Started', href: '/start' })"
    :secondary-button="JSON.stringify({ label: 'Login', href: '/login' })"
    class="w-full"
  />
</template>

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-kit/floating-menu-element.js"></script>

<motion-floating-menu
  menu-groups='[{"title":"Explore","links":[{"label":"Home","href":"/"},{"label":"About","href":"/about"}]},{"title":"Resources","variant":"muted","links":[{"label":"Blog","href":"/blog"}]}]'
  logo-html="<svg width='24' height='24' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2'><circle cx='12' cy='12' r='10'/></svg>"
  primary-button='{"label":"Get Started","href":"/start"}'
  secondary-button='{"label":"Login","href":"/login"}'
  class="w-full"
/>

props.name: menu-groups
props.description: JSON string array of menu groups. Each group has title, optional variant ('default' or 'muted'), and links array with label and href.

props.name: logo-html
props.description: HTML string for the logo displayed in the header (SVG or image tag).

props.name: primary-button
props.description: JSON string with label and href for the primary CTA button.

props.name: secondary-button
props.description: JSON string with label and href for the secondary button (hidden on mobile).
